_info: CODE SHIELD lock list (guardrails/shield.py). Each lock: a file (the whole file is locked), a reason, the tests that protect it and the approved fingerprint.
The fingerprint is never written by hand: 'python3 guardrails/shield.py approve <name> --reason "..."' writes it and logs the change to docs/SHIELD_LOG.md.
{tests} in a runner command is replaced by the lock's test files.

locks.name: session-refresh
locks.reason: Single-flight refresh; only a rejected refresh ends the session, a network failure never signs the user out (docs/decisions/0003).

locks.name: auth-retry
locks.reason: A 401 refreshes once and retries once; a second 401 is final, so a bad token can't loop (docs/decisions/0003).
